extracted.name: Strawberry sandos
extracted.description: Pack up a family picnic and take these moreish Japanese-inspired sweet sandwiches for dessert, filled with sweet whipped cream and strawberries
ingredient_lines: 8 slices of soft white bread (ideally milk bread)
500g strawberries (ensure they’re similarly sized), hulled and halved
instruction_lines: Whip the cream, sugar and vanilla (if using) together using an electric whisk until soft peaks form. Spread the whipped cream over the bread slices. Arrange the strawberries, cut-side down, over the cream on half the bread slices, then sandwich together with the remaining bread.
Cut the crusts off the sandos, if you like, then halve along the middle to create triangles. Wrap in baking parchment to take on a picnic.
